sources.title: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo - GitHub
sources.snippet: Our model can generate 121-frame videos at 24 FPS with a resolution of 1280×704 in just 4 steps, eliminating the need for the CFG trick. To the best of our knowledge, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Turbo is the first open-source repository of the distilled I2V version of Wan2.2-TI2V-5B.

sources.title: Fastwan AI - Next-Generation Video Generation in Seconds
sources.snippet: What is Fastwan AI? Fastwan AI represents a breakthrough in video generation technology. Built on the foundation of Wan models, it introduces sparse distillation - a novel training method that combines video sparse attention with step distillation to achieve unprecedented speed improvements while maintaining high-quality output.
